primary_interest.quote: I know you came in wanting to talk voice AI agents for appointment booking.

use_case.quote: customers book things like in-store fittings, delivery slots, and installation visits. Right now it's all humans on phones. We want voice agents handling that.

inference_framing.quote: We're not looking to buy inference as a standalone thing. It only matters if it powers the agent.

inference_raised_by.quote: the language model is what makes the agent work, and we host it.

competitors_inference.quote: we've got a quote from Together AI at about $0.81 per million tokens.

decision_criteria.quote: Our preference is to consolidate with whoever already holds our cloud and AI relationships

stated_reason.quote: breadth matters. If we're locked to two models, that's a problem.
